comments.value:
Yeah, I agree. Not necessary for Forced, but I'm not against it, since it's rarely needed over Dynamic but Dynamic 100% should stay there once enabled. Keep "off" for Default Setting though.

Occasionally, you'll come across worlds that look weird on Dynamic and even more rarely ones that look really broken on Forced. But it never stopped me from turning the Setting off if necessary.

Even if it did somehow "crash" you and stopped you from being able to get into VR again (don't see how or believe this could happen at all - but saying just in case), you can delete the settings file in your VRChat folder on your PC to reset back to Default settings so shrug.

Please. It is ludicrous that I have to change this every time I launch the game. Having it forced off each session causes more issues than it has ever caused being on. 

Don't even need to make it easier to find as long as I can go set it and never touch it again. Trusting external links is way more of a risk and I only had to change that setting once. I just want to see my damn arms as tiny man.
YES!!! I have to change this setting every time I log in, every session. It is highly annoying. Would rather have it on or have the toggle be persistent.

As someone who spends a lot of time at minimum height, having the option for this to be static would be incredibly helpful. Especially during game crashes it is frustrating to have to reset this setting every time.
I'd also like this setting added to the JSON settings file in my VRC folder
I think this has been added in the most recent update.

@{66c20b96ad2964590e7d838d|full_name} in practice this effects all worlds with sight lines or travel distances longer than 1000m, which includes ALL flight worlds, ALL driving worlds, most outdoor worlds that have distant scenery whether it is accessible or not. The implementation of this without a way for worlds to override it has been catastrophic.

details: Yes keep the warning, but please make this setting persistent. Its very annoying to always have to turn this on.
title: Persistent forced camera near distance

voters.name: ・馬刺丸＠あざと可愛い桜ちゃん
